signal: completed-close distance_ema48 > 0, frozen parent six-feature bank
entry_rule: on flat-to-positive EMA, initialize units using the same contemporaneous EMA risk target and cost-inclusive budget as R1
hold_rule: keep market units exactly while EMA stays positive and projected post-cost position meets risk constraints; no top-up to a NAV fraction or after a risk trim
exit_rule: close when EMA is nonpositive; terminal liquidation at the shared endpoint
risk_trim_rule: only reduce tentative units if exact projected post-cost asset/gross/volatility constraints fail; use a conservative NAV lower bound for a single bounded downscale

risk.covariance_update: daily; last data strictly before UTC decision day

funding: same frozen modeled_rates.json as parent including eight terminal-settlement rows; rate times current units times reference close
execution: same assumed completed close held constant until modeled fill; fractional units, no observed fills/marks qualification

bootstrap.bank: reuse pinned common primary/audit/sensitivity banks from forecast4h_v1
